name: ide-roslyn
author: lumine-code
description: Provide C# language features with Roslyn.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to roslyn-language-server or its DLL. Leave empty to use the managed installation, then PATH.

dotnetPath.title: .NET Path
dotnetPath.description: Absolute path to dotnet. Leave empty to use PATH. Install a .NET 10 SDK to run Roslyn and load MSBuild projects; preserve the SDKs required by project global.json files.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Offer to install Roslyn when no language server can be found.

parameterHints.title: Parameter Hints
parameterHints.description: Control Roslyn inline parameter names. Server Default preserves its choice.

typeHints.title: Type Hints
typeHints.description: Control Roslyn inline inferred types. Server Default preserves its choice.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which Roslyn features the editor uses. References code lenses require a client command that the editor does not implement.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show method parameters while entering arguments.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Navigate to source, metadata, types and implementations.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find symbol uses across the project.

callHierarchy.title: Call Hierarchy
callHierarchy.description: Navigate between methods and their callers.

typeHierarchy.title: Type Hierarchy
typeHierarchy.description: Navigate between base and derived types.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format documents and selections with Roslyn.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Show parameter names and inferred types inline.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Classify C# symbols with semantic information.
